label: Conventional Box Truck
generated: measured off the rig source by hand-transcription with per-value provenance; no generator in the rig

frame.origin: ground-centre of the body footprint (bumpers excluded from the centring; z=0 is the road)
frame.at_rest: every value here is at susF=susR=0, doors and roll-up shut, hood down, liftgate stowed, fairing fitted. See LIFTGATE and HOOD for what moves.

pivot_px._note: NOT the 384x320 road cell — this body is too long and its grounded liftgate reaches 6.52 m aft. The ground row (214) is kept, so model z=0 still projects to the same road plane as the rest of the fleet, in all 8 facings.

VARIANTS._what: NONE. No roof heights, no glass options. Two PART toggles cover the class builds.

liftgate._note: false removes the tuck-under mechanism entirely and nothing else changes — same bumperettes, same ICC bar, same published z table. Decide it at spawn.

fairing._note: the cab roof fairing. false removes the cap and moves the five amber ID lamps down onto the bare cab roof; NO published z changes — the box (3.68) owns the skyline either way, and the painted top row is identical (the harness asserts it).

collider_bbox._note: the painted front fenders are the widest hard point (2.50 m); the box is 2.44. Mirrors reach 2.68 over — add 0.09 m per side above z 1.58 if they must be solid.

ground_clearance_m.source: rear diff tube r 0.16 centred z 0.45 (buildWheels)
ground_clearance_m._note: mudflaps are rubber — sweep them, do not collide them. The stowed liftgate is STEEL at 0.44 m: it does collide.

BODY.provenance: BODIES.convBox + G; mirrors from buildCab boxes |1.24..1.34|

CAB._what: a two-seat day cab BEHIND the engine: flat floor, no doghouse — the hump is the cabover's problem, not this one's.

floor.provenance: buildCab floor slab at G.cabFloorZ; headliner z 2.74

CAB.flat: the floor is FLAT wall to wall — the engine sits ahead of the firewall (y 2.44). Cross-cab route is unobstructed.

floor.provenance: buildBox floor slab at G.boxFloorZ — exact

door_entry._note: the opening head (3.40) is 0.20 under the ceiling — tall cargo clears the bay but not the door

obstructions._note: the open door lies flat under the ceiling over the aft 2.4 m of bay — 2.42 m of headroom stands there while the door is up

CARGO.flat: NO wheel tubs, no step, no hump — the 1.10 m floor rides ABOVE the duals, flat wall to wall over all 6.10 m.

motion.rule: 15 slats climb a vertical track 2.30 m in the rear plane (y -5.03), bend forward and stack flat at z 3.52 under the ceiling

keep_clear._note: NONE. Zero swept volume behind the truck — the door never leaves the body, and the painted bbox at N is identical closed and open (the harness asserts it). Loading clearance behind the tail is the LIFTGATE's, not the door's.

boarding._note: sill = cargo floor, true dock height. Bare, it is a climb; the liftgate at gate=1 is the step

reach_point._note: NOT tested against ground colliders, and it stands ON the liftgate keep-clear — see _confirm.reach_vs_gate

keep_clear._note: sweep of the free edge about the hinge axis; the collider is the arc, not the leaf. The doors do NOT ride the hood — they stay with the cab.

boarding._note: two frame-mounted steps then the floor — see STEP

reach_point._note: outside the swept disc; NOT tested against ground colliders

mirror.rides: the CAB (A-pillar arms), not this door

LIFTGATE._what: a tuck-under liftgate on the tail: one 0..1 param, three phases, and the only thing on this truck that wants clearance behind it.

swing.what: the folded platform swings out from under the tail to dock height, level with the cargo floor

unfold.what: the flip half rotates 180deg aft — full 1.26 m platform at dock height, flush with the sill

lower.what: parallel arms lower the level platform to the ground

stowed._note: folded double under the tail, inside the LOA — nothing pokes past the bumperettes

deployed._note: the platform plan while gate > 0.45; during the swing (0..0.45) the same rectangle is swept at and below dock height

loading_zone._note: a working margin for the hand truck and the loader — a REQUEST, not geometry

HOOD.rides: the whole FRONT CLIP: hood top and cheeks, both fenders and their arches, arch liners, grille, headlamps — one group
HOOD.stays: front bumper, frame, engine, CAB (doors, mirrors, steps), box, roll-up, liftgate, wheels

latches._note: twin hood latches at the cowl corners — a repair interaction has handles to pull

HOOD.extreme: at hood=1 the hood nose reaches y 4.87 at z 0.81 and the fender corners y 4.78 — 0.57 m past the bumper. Do not open against a wall.
HOOD._note: this class has a HOOD, not a tilt cab — the cab, its doors and their arcs never move. The rig will happily open the hood at speed; see _confirm.
HOOD.provenance: buildHoodClip part() + rotX about G.hoodHinge; G.hoodDeg = 70

STEP._note: two fixed treads per side under the doors — 0.38, 0.70, then the 0.98 m floor. They are FRAME parts: they ride the suspension but NOT the hood. The liftgate at gate=1 is the only step into the BOX.

TOW._note: NOTHING. No ball, no pintle, no fifth wheel, no front recovery points. The ICC underride bar (y -5.26..-5.20, z 0.40..0.48) is a safety bar, not a coupling — do not let a game hang a trailer on it.

SUSPENSION.applies_to: the whole body group (frame, hood clip, cab, box, roll-up, liftgate in any phase) — the wheels do NOT move
SUSPENSION.consequence: every polygon in CAB, CARGO, THRESHOLD, LIFTGATE and HOOD rides that dz; t extrapolates past both axles so the bumpers pitch further than the travel.

WHEELS._note: roll is per-CORNER (wFL wFR wRL wRR, REVOLUTIONS) — each dual pair shares its corner's roll. One revolution (2.827 m) closes to 1 stray pixel: 27.001 tread stripes of 0.1047 m plus 8-fold lugs. A half revolution lands mid-stripe, so the roll cue visibly moves.
WHEELS.provenance: G.frontWX / dualXi / dualXo / axF / axR / wheelR / tireW — exact

STEERING.sense: +1 = full LEFT lock; the nose swings toward -x
STEERING.ackermann: outer = atan(1/(1/tan(inner) + track/wheelbase)), front track 1.72 m, wheelbase 6.10 m
STEERING.axis: vertical, through each front wheel centre — no kingpin offset, caster or scrub radius is modelled

turning_radius_m._note: geometric, at full lock. The BIGGEST lock in the pack (35deg to the cabover's 33) — and still a wider circle than the cabover's 6.34, because 6.10 m of wheelbase taxes every degree. That trade is the tier's whole argument.

swept_envelope._note: at full lock a front tire corner stands 0.21 m proud of the cab side but 17 mm INSIDE the painted fenders — the fenders are the collider width and the lock stops at 35deg to keep it that way.

STEERING.does_not: yaw the truck. STEERING turns the wheels; YAW turns the machine. A turning truck wants both.

YAW.what: heading between the eight facings. The model turns about z before projection under a FIXED key, so the shading is rebaked for the new heading — this is not a rotated sprite.
YAW.pivot: unaffected; the origin projects to the published pivot at any yaw
YAW.frame: yaw is a RENDER param, not geometry. Every metre in this file is in the machine frame and does not move with it.
YAW.gameplay: a heading is dir*45 + yaw. Colliders, reach points and seat refs rotate with the machine as they always did; nothing here needs a yaw correction.

exhaust_tip._note: street side, aft of the duals — smoke/heat FX attach. NO vertical stack on this build.

fuel_tank._note: the tank is modelled; the filler neck is not (see _excluded)

fairing._note: carries the five amber ID lamps; fairing:false moves them to the bare roof at z 2.92

box_roof._note: sign/rack attach; no rack is modelled and no route up exists

dock_sill._note: the alignment point for backing to a dock or a quay edge

INTERACT._note: the control pendant hangs at the curb-side tail corner

_interact_notes.reach_point: a request, not a promise — a ground-level standing spot derived from which face the item is on. NOT validated against terrain, kerb or another vehicle.
_interact_notes.visible_facings: the near-side test paint() uses: a feature with outward normal n is listed for facing d when nx*sin(d*45) + ny*cos(d*45) < -0.3, edge-on excluded. Top faces are visible at all eight.

_excluded.CLEATS: not a hull, and nothing on this truck couples to anything — see TOW.
_excluded.walkable_roof: a 2.28 x 6.06 m panel at z 3.68 with no rack, no rail and no route up. Omitted rather than published as a surface.
_excluded.fuel_fill: no filler neck, cap or door is modelled anywhere on the body. The tank is in ATTACH.fuel_tank.
_excluded.exhaust_stack: no vertical stack — this build runs under-frame exhaust. The chrome stack is the SEMI tier's cue, not the box truck's.
_excluded.rear_cab_window: none — the box front stands 0.20 m behind the cab wall; there is nothing to see.
_excluded.plate_and_wipers: no licence plate, wipers, aerial or decals. At 32 px/m they are 1-3 px and were left out of the bake.
_excluded.spare_wheel: no spare is modelled, slung or otherwise.
_excluded.dock_bumpers: no rubber dock blocks on the tail — the bumperettes are steel and the sill plate is bare galv.
_excluded.interior_INTERACT: nothing inside is an interactable — no glovebox, radio or handbrake in the rig.

_confirm.cargo_walkable: CARGO.floor is a 2.28 x 6.10 m rubber sole 1.10 m up under 2.50 m of headroom. Whether a player walks it (vs. it being a container) is unruled. It is published as geometry either way.
_confirm.gate_load: the platform is drawn, not rated. Pallet-vs-person capacity, overload behaviour and whether it lifts a vehicle are gameplay's call.
_confirm.gate_phase_stops: gate is one continuous 0..1. A game that wants 'dock work' should HOLD 0.70 (unfolded, level with the floor) — nothing in the rig detents there.
_confirm.reach_vs_gate: the rollup reach point [0,-5.75,0] stands inside the liftgate's deployed rectangle. With the gate down it is ON the platform; with the gate stowed it is clear road. Sequence the two or move the loader.
_confirm.rollup_headroom: 2.30 m passes through the door; 2.42 m stands under the open stack (CARGO.obstructions.rollup_stack). Close the door before standing the tallest crate at the tail.
_confirm.dock_height: the sill is 1.10 m — a true dock-height floor, 0.18 over the cabover's. Harbour quay and warehouse dock heights are the WORLD's numbers; the truck publishes its own and takes no position on the gap.
_confirm.hood_discipline: nothing couples the hood to motion, doors or gear. A game that opens the clip at 80 km/h gets exactly that. The rig will not stop it.
_confirm.mirror_collider: BODY.collider_bbox stops at the fenders (2.50 m). The mirrors reach 2.68 m over — decide before a mirror clips a doorframe.
_confirm.steering_and_yaw: STEERING moves the wheels only; YAW moves the machine. Nothing couples them — a game that turns the wheels without yawing (or the reverse) will look wrong, and the rig will not stop it.
_confirm.cell_rule: this kit's cell is 448 x 352 @ 224,214 — NOT the 384 road cell. Pack from THIS contract's painted_bbox, never from a sibling's.
